pricing.notes: FLAGGED. fitbod.me publishes no pricing page — /pricing 404s and the homepage shows none. The App Store in-app purchase list mixes current and legacy SKUs without labelling billing periods: "fitbod ELITE $9.99", "fitbod ELITE $59.99", plus "Monthly Plan $12.99 (Legacy Pricing)", "Monthly Plan $15.99 (Legacy Pricing)" and "A Year of Fitbod Elite $79.99 (Legacy Pricing)". $9.99 is read as the current monthly rate and needs a human check.
